owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — shared test composition (test-support: test) under #2748, #3967: the shared fixtures stop importing the Organisation & Tenancy domain (organization-tenancy/domain: models/platform) and the Audit Platform domain (audit-platform/domain: models/audit). The outbox test double moves to a new owner test-support point (organization-tenancy: models/platform/platformtest); the fixtures map the platform and audit rows they write themselves.
atomic_cutover: One test-support change without an ADR or epoch. CapturingOutbox moves unchanged from test to models/platform/platformtest, a new organization-tenancy/test-support point beside the outbox port it implements (pattern of #3944 slice A); its rule to organization-tenancy/domain and the test-support/test-support -> organization-tenancy/test-support rule are anchored to that candidate-created point (ruleAnchoredToCandidateOnlyPoint) and carry no issue. test keeps the aliases CapturingOutbox and NewCapturingOutbox, so the careplan and identityaccess suites are unchanged. CreateTestOperator, CreateTestOperatorWithEmail and CreateTestOperatorWithPassword return a test-owned Operator row and CreateTestOrganization takes and returns a test-owned Organization row (test/platform_rows.go, the columns and tags of models/platform); the type check over every package with tests found no caller handing the operator to production code, and the two organization callers build the fixture row instead of the model. Audit vocabulary, per type: DataDeletion, NewDataDeletion and DeletionTypeManual become the test-owned DataDeletion row with the stored values (deletion type manual, empty metadata); EnrollmentOfferingAdjustment becomes a test-owned row with its table named explicitly; StammdatenSectionSchoolClasses becomes the stored section value school-classes, which the only caller compares in raw SQL; AuthEvent, AuthEventRepository, GuardianFinancialChange, GuardianFinancialChangeCreator and Command give way to the generic NewAuditCommand over a trail's Create method, which satisfies the Audit command port structurally and still refuses foreign event types; BookingConsistencyRepository and Date give way to the function type BookingConsistencyAudit with the fixture-owned BookingConsistencyFindings, which the Audit integration suite builds from its repository (TotalFindings stays the report's own method). No fixture grant to audit-platform/public or a test-support point is needed. Two keys fall (86 -> 84). No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
